title: They Never Look Up
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/7ws3CCPcdmU (premise only: the infected never look up)
summary: A window cleaner is stuck on a platform thirty floors up when the outbreak starts. She learns one rule. Then it breaks.

beats.text: I clean windows for a living. Thirty floors up, on a platform the size of a bed.
That morning, the city below me started screaming.
People ran. Then the people chasing them stopped running, and started wandering.
My phone said: stay where you are. Help is coming.
So I stayed. For three days, I watched them. And I learned one thing.
I ate the last of my lunch. I drank the rain.
On the fourth night, the platform motor coughed, and died.
The cable groaned. One of them, right below me, stopped walking.
Slowly, very slowly, it tilted its head...
